summary: The legal input contains at most ten decimal digits, which is too small to support a stable runtime trend between linear digit processing and repeated prefix rebuilding.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 0 through 10^9 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The protected loop removes one decimal digit per iteration, performs constant-time lookup and arithmetic, and therefore executes at most ten iterations with constant auxiliary storage.

The permanent certificate regression checks every integer below 100000, every invalid digit at every position through nine digits, deterministic values across the full bound including 10^9, all authored cases, and both protected source forms against an independent string-rotation oracle.
